items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: With my uncle, Ken Schoen, Dave Poitkin, John Robichaud, all of those men.

ctx.x: Clem. That's, that name's familiar too. I remember that name. Clem. Oh, yes. Clem, he had a son with his son with me. Yeah. Eddward Clem. All of them was in my uncle's class and my husband come along, a young boy under them. They had the Indiana Brass Band then. The Indiana. The Indiana Brass Band. See? And George, and who else? George was the youngest carnet player in the band. My George. He was the youngest in the band. Now, he was always with those older men. With my uncle, Ken Schoen, Dave Poitkin, John…
By the way, when did you get married to Mr. I got married in 1905.
